verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents deposit-frequency configuration per merchant (settlement cadence) and states platforms retain and can export payment/merchant data at any time, plus webhooks for status changes and billing profiles for fee calculation — but there is no evidence of a dedicated settlement/balance reconciliation report (per-seller or rolled-up) or a scheduled file/API feed built for finance-stack consumption. missing for 10: explicit settlement/balance reconciliation reports, per-seller and rolled-up aggregation, scheduled file or API delivery mechanism for finance systems.
